title: Geekvape Wenax Q2 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Geek Vape Wenax Q2 Pod Vape Kit blends sleek, contemporary aesthetics with simple, intuitive usability in a compact, lightweight pod system built for everyday use. Backed by a high-capacity 1250mAh battery and delivering up to 30W of power, this kit supports both mouth-to-lung (MTL) and restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) vaping styles with ease. A single button controls key functions while the built-in smart mode auto-selects the optimal wattage for your pod. The bright OLED display shows battery life and puff data, and the adjustable airflow slider lets you fine-tune your inhale. The kit is inhale-activated for a seamless experience, with the option to press the fire button if preferred. The Wenax Q2 is compatible with the Geek Vape Q Pod range and comes supplied with two refillable mesh coil pods: one 0.6ohm for RDL and one 1.2ohm for MTL. Each pod holds up to 2ml of e-liquid and features a leak-resistant side-fill design for simple top-ups on the go. Once the coil is spent, just swap the entire pod for a fresh one—no mess, no maintenance. For best results, the Wenax Q2 is recommended with nicotine salts and 50/50 VG/PG e-liquids for smooth flavour and satisfying performance. This lightweight, reliable kit is ideal for vapers seeking a high-quality, low-hassle setup that delivers excellent flavour and control without overcomplicating things. Kit Colours: Available in a wide range of stylish colourways: Fiber Black, Vinca Blue, Lilac Purple, Monet Blue, Sunset Dune, Powder Pink, Ruby Amber, Summer Lime, Mocha Mousse Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen vape juice before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
